body:
Founder real-time, live gameplay QA: 'AT ONE POINT I GOT STUCK SIDEWAYS AND HE WAS LIKE TRYING TO ROTATE TO RUN WHERE I WANTED BUT KIND ACOULDNT' -> 'CAN WE ADD LOGS TO HELP DEBUG IT?' -> 'MAYBE WE MAKE A RESET CHARACER BUTTON...' -> 'LOG ALL OF THAT AND KEEP MOVING'.

Server-side: every real PACKET_ARENA_MOVE now logs [move-debug] (target, current position, facing, and every real movement-blocking state: rooted_ms/stunned_ms/attack_windup_ms_remaining/casting_slot), readable from var/logs/matchmaker-bots.log. Client-side: new F10 debug key forces the local hero's own client-side hero_facing_rad back to a known value and logs the real before/after, giving a concrete data point next time the bug recurs.

Deliberately NOT a fix -- root cause not found yet (founder's own explicit call: 'IM NOT TOTALLY SURE LOG IT AND KLEEP MOVING', 'I THINK A DEATH FIXES IT SO ITS NOT THE END OF THE WORLD' -- low priority, non-blocking). The rebuilt arena_server binary is already live for the NEXT match automatically (the matchmaker execs a fresh server process per match from build/red_garden_arena_server, no service restart needed) -- an in-progress match at the time of this commit would still be running the old binary until it ends. REDGARDEN commit 1bb0369.

⚓ ☃
title: Real move-command diagnostics + F10 reset-rotation debug tool for the live rotation/movement bug report
